hero.h:
Talk it out,
and it becomes a story
hero.p:
Say your idea out loud. We shape it into a four-act, 24-block story map.
The hook stays yours.

problem.h:
You have the idea,
but not the next scene
problem.p:
Most stories stop somewhere between having an idea and knowing what happens next.
The problem is not a blank page. It is a blank structure.

turn.p:
A lighthouse keeper, a younger sibling, a storm, a feeling of guilt. Your words become character, scene, and emotion cards.
Keep answering and the story grows. Say none and move on.

structure.h:
Cards find their place
on 24 blocks
structure.p:
Four acts, three turning points, an antagonist that rises three times.
A master storyteller's method, turned into an engine.

library.h:
A master's skeleton
waits beside you
library.p:
Stories people loved are mapped in the same 24-block frame.
Choose a shape and place it beside your own story.

done.h:
The structure is the engine,
the hook stays yours
done.p:
The engine sets up the bones and the cause-and-effect.
The feeling, detail, and one thing only this story can do remain yours.

try.p:
The beta is free and starts without a login.
We will email you when the full release is ready.
